brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Dozeline, the iOS and Android wind-down and sleep journal app in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: calm, warm, not clinical, no moons or stars cliché. The app icon must be recognisable on a home screen at small sizes. English and Turkish markets.

claim.notes: Dusk Arch geçti (6,77) ve insufficient-evidence riski kabulüyle kesinleştirildi; tucked-d ve settling-line elendi, marka tescil taraması ve Türkçe ad kontrolü açık.

concepts.title: Dusk Arch
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 two offset blocks / glitch; s2 lowercase d split amber over clay, maybe a half-sunk sun; s3 ice-cream or mushroom or burger; s4 padlock/door tile; s5 door icon with a box. Keep s2: it is the only one that is the letter d (D for Dozeline, works in Turkish) and carries the dusk idea through a two-tone dim-line, 96% at 16 px. Fix: make the cut and the bowl offset more deliberate so it does not read as a plain half-and-half d or a pram; check the amber/clay contrast in one colour.

concepts.title: Settling Line
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 arch/n/horseshoe handle; s2 mouth or bow tie; s3 cinnamon roll/hypnosis spiral/G; s4 music note. None says sleep or d at 16px, and s1 is a generic arch. Drop the direction.

concepts.title: Tucked D
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 D with a diagonal slash/cut-off corner; s2 D or padlock/mailbox slot; s3 dog-eared document icon (struck); s4 glitch-sliced D/5 (struck). Keep s1: clear D, ownable diagonal silhouette. Make the cut deeper and the flap read at 16px in silhouette alone (it must not look like a generic slashed D); keep the rose flap warm, not a second letter.
